whyThisMatters:
A local real-estate media business. It offers HDR photography (20–50 edited photos, sky replacement, object removal, "MLS-ready the next business day"), 4K/6K video, Zillow 3D tours, drone shots and virtual staging. Photography starts at 250, dollars video from 150 dollars bundled, 3D tour from 50 dollars bundled, 24–48h turnaround, "25+ cities served", online booking. It also sells web design for agents.

Every listing needs photos before it goes live, and agents rebook the photographer they trust. Software (online booking, Stripe checkout, editing outsourcing) turns a one-person shoot business into a repeatable ops machine.

An agent cannot publish a listing until the photos exist. This shop in Jacksonville shoots the photos, the video, the drone, and the 3D tour, and it also does virtual staging and sites for agents. The turnaround is the next day or two. You pay per shoot, not on a subscription. The last year of Stripe is the book of those jobs.
